items.title: Probably the only public demo of a real-time, multi-agent AI governance system
items.raw_excerpt:
I've built a functioning AI governance system called "Nel" in my living room over 7 months.
As a solo developer with no formal background, I wanted to see if I could create something
that could handle ethical debates between AI models and evolve its own constitution. What it does:
- Routes queries through 5 different AI models (Mistral, Llama2, etc.)
- Appoints a formal "Challenger" model to force debate
- Autonomously detects dissent using confidence thresholds
- Flags ethical conflicts for constitutional review
- Runs fully offline on a single machine Proof it works - here's the system handling the trolley problem:
www.tiktok.com/@neuraledge_limitless/video/7560316804069952790 Terminal output showing the entire dissent detection process: This isn't theoretical - it's running right now. I

title_i18n.en: Probably the only public demo of a real-time, multi-agent AI governance system
title_i18n.zh: 这可能是实时多智能体人工智能治理系统的唯一公开演示。
title_i18n.es: Probablemente la única demostración pública de un sistema de gobernanza de IA en tiempo real y multiagente.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 我在客厅里花了七个月时间，独自开发出一套名为Nel的实用人工智能治理系统。作为没有专业背景的独立开发者，我想验证自己能否构建出处理伦理辩论的机制。
excerpt_i18n.es: He construido un sistema de gobernanza de IA funcional llamado Nel en mi salón durante siete meses. Como desarrollador en solitario sin formación formal, quería ver si podía crear algo capaz de gestionar debates éticos.

items.title: Ask HN: How are senior SWEs using AI?
items.raw_excerpt: I’m a SWE with ~5.5 years of professional experience now and anecdotally see AI used primarily by juniors who use it as a crutch. Moreover, the vast majority of the “best” engineers I know do not use any AI-assisted coding tools (e.g. Copilot). They do, however, occasionally use LLMs as a search engine for unqualified questions (I.e. where they identify that there are unknown unknowns). Is my anecdotal experience representative of reality? If not, I’d love to hear peoples’ workflows (especially the historical high performers)

items.title: 连续发布两款万亿参数模型，蚂蚁 AI 来势汹汹
items.raw_excerpt: 刚刚过去的国庆，各行各业进入放假模式，但大模型行业却一刻也没闲着。 过去的半个月，国内外大模型的头部团队有十余款重磅产品发布，但每个团队的产品侧重不同。 其中，九月下旬，阿里发布以 Qwen3-Max 为代表的全家桶产品，大秀了一把肌肉；九月末，DeepSeek 和 Anthropic 瞄准真实编程场景，先后发布了 DeepSeek V3.2-Exp 和 Claude Sonnet 4.5，此外，智谱也拿出 GLM-4.6，目标冲击国内最强代码模型。 有人全盘布局，也有人专攻精尖，在大模型领域竞争驶向深水区后，各个公司战略路线出现了分野。 10 月 9 日凌晨，蚂蚁百灵大模型团队奇袭般官宣了一款自家最新语言大模型 Ling-1T，参数量达到 1000B（即 1万亿参数）。然而，就在十天前，百灵团队才将自研 Ring-1T-preview 大模型开源。 短短十天内，发布并开源两款万亿参数模型，如此密集的产品发布让蚂蚁百灵大模型成为了行业热议对象。 与此同时，这样毫无保留的开源动作，也让业界猜测：蚂蚁到底意图何在？ 01 探索智能上限是终极目标 据雷峰网了解，蚂蚁集团研发的基础大模型取名“百灵”，寓意“百试百灵”，也蕴含科技普惠之意，和阿里一样，蚂蚁也是独立团队独立研发，Ling-1T 和 Ring-1T-preview 分别是蚂蚁百灵团队研发的非思考模型和思考模型。 过去半年时间里，蚂蚁一直在对百灵大模型进行迭代优化，并且自上而下形成了三条技术探索路线： 一条是以 MoE 架构为基础的非思考模型 Ling-Series，另一条是思考模型 R

title_i18n.es: Ante la presentación consecutiva de dos modelos con billones de parámetros, Ant AI llega con fuerza arrolladora.

excerpt_i18n.en: During the recent National Day holiday, while various industries went on break, the large model sector remained highly active. Over the past two weeks, over ten major products were launched by leading teams globally, each with distinct focuses. In late September, Alibaba showcased its strength with a comprehensive suite of products, including Qwen3-Max. At the end of September, DeepSeek and Anthropic targeted real-world programming scenarios, releasing DeepSeek V3.2-Exp and Claude Sonnet 4.5, respectively. Additionally, Zhipu introduced GLM-4.6, aiming to become the top code model in China. As competition in the large model field intensifies, companies' strategies have diverged, with some pursuing broad layouts and others specializing in precision. On the early morning of October 9, Ant Group's Bailing large model team unexpectedly announced its latest language model, Ling-1T, with 1000B parameters. Remarkably, just ten days prior, the team had open-sourced its self-developed Ring-1T-preview model. Releasing and open-sourcing two trillion-parameter models in such a short span highlights Ant Bailing's rapid pace.
excerpt_i18n.es: Durante las recientes vacaciones nacionales, mientras diversos sectores entraban en modo de descanso, la industria de los grandes modelos no se detuvo ni un instante. En las últimas dos semanas, más de diez equipos líderes de modelos a gran escala, tanto nacionales como internacionales, lanzaron productos destacados, aunque cada equipo se centró en aspectos distintos. A finales de septiembre, Alibaba presentó su conjunto completo de productos, destacando Qwen3-Max para demostrar su fortaleza; a finales de mes, DeepSeek y Anthropic, enfocándose en escenarios de programación real, lanzaron sucesivamente DeepSeek V3.2-Exp y C.
